paragraphs: Revolucija 14. julija, znana tudi kot iraški vojaški udar leta 1958, je bil vojaški udar 14. julija 1958 v Iraku, ki je strmoglavil kralja Fejsala II. in hašemitsko Kraljevino Irak. Iraška republika, ki je nastala po njem, je končala hašemitsko arabsko federacijo Iraka in Jordanije, ustanovljeno komaj šest mesecev prej.

source.title: 14 July Revolution
paragraphs: The 14 July Revolution, also known as the 1958 Iraqi military coup, was a military coup that took place on 14 July 1958 in Iraq, resulting in the toppling of King Faisal II and the overthrow of the Hashemite-led Kingdom of Iraq. The Iraqi Republic established in its wake ended the Hashemite Arab Federation between Iraq and Jordan that had been established just six months earlier.

Revolucija 17. julija (arabsko: inqilāb 17 Tammūz) je bil nekrvav državni udar v Iraku leta 1968, ki so ga vodili Ahmed Hasan al Bakr, Abd ar Razak an Naif in Abd ar Rahman al Davud. Odstavil je predsednika Abdula Rahmana Arifa in predsednika vlade Tahirja Jahjo ter na oblast pripeljal iraško regionalno vejo Arabske socialistične stranke Baath. Med baatisti, ki so sodelovali v udaru in poznejši čistki zmerne frakcije pod vodstvom Naifa, so bili Hardan al Tikriti, Salih Mahdi Amaš in poznejši iraški predsednik Sadam Husein. Udar je bil uperjen predvsem proti Jahji, odkritemu naseristu, ki je politično krizo po šestdnevni vojni junija 1967 izkoristil, da bi Arifovo zmerno vlado prisilil k nacionalizaciji družbe Iraq Petroleum Company (IPC) v zahodni lasti, da bi Irak lahko »nafto uporabil kot orožje v boju proti Izraelu«. Do popolne nacionalizacije IPC je prišlo šele leta 1972, pod baatistično oblastjo. Po udaru je nova iraška vlada utrdila oblast z obtožbami o domnevnih ameriških in izraelskih spletkah, med širšo čistko je zaradi izmišljenih obtožb vohunjenja javno usmrtila 14 ljudi, med njimi 9 iraških Judov, in krepila tradicionalno tesne odnose s Sovjetsko zvezo.

source.title: 17 July Revolution
paragraphs: The 17 July Revolution (Arabic: انقلاب 17 تموز, romanized: inqilāb 17 Tammūz) was a bloodless coup in Iraq in 1968 led by Ahmed Hassan al-Bakr, Abd ar-Razzaq an-Naif, and Abd ar-Rahman al-Dawud that ousted President Abdul Rahman Arif and Prime Minister Tahir Yahya and brought the Iraqi Regional Branch of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party to power. Ba'athists involved in the coup as well as the subsequent purge of the moderate faction led by Naif included Hardan al-Tikriti, Salih Mahdi Ammash, and Saddam Hussein, the future President of Iraq. The coup was primarily directed against Yahya, an outspoken Nasserist who exploited the political crisis created by the June 1967 Six-Day War to push Arif's moderate government to nationalize the Western-owned Iraq Petroleum Company (IPC) in order to use Iraq's "oil as a weapon in the battle against Israel." Full nationalization of the IPC did not occur until 1972, under the Ba'athist administration. In the aftermath of the coup, the new Iraqi government consolidated power by denouncing alleged American and Israeli machinations, publicly executing 14 people including 9 Iraqi Jews on fabricated espionage charges amidst a broader purge, and working to expand Iraq's traditionally close relations with the Soviet Union.

1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and.headline: Državljanski spopad v Libanonskem gorovju in Damasku leta 1860
paragraphs: Državljanski spopad v Libanonskem gorovju in Damasku leta 1860, znan tudi kot krščansko-druzovska vojna leta 1860, je bil državljanski spopad v Libanonskem gorovju v času osmanske oblasti v letih 1860–1861, v katerem so se bojevali predvsem tamkajšnji Druzi in kristjani.

Po odločilnih zmagah Druzov in pokolih kristjanov se je spopad razširil v druge dele osmanske Sirije, zlasti v Damask, kjer so druzovski borci in krajevne muslimanske skupine pobili na tisoče kristjanov. Boji so sprožili mednarodno vojaško posredovanje pod francoskim vodstvom.

source.title: 1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus
paragraphs: The 1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus, also known as the 1860 Christian–Druze war, was a civil conflict in Mount Lebanon during Ottoman rule in 1860–1861 fought mainly between the local Druze and Christians.

Following decisive Druze victories and massacres of the Christians, the conflict spilled over into other parts of Ottoman Syria, particularly Damascus, where thousands of Christian residents were killed by Druze fighters and local Muslim groups. The fighting precipitated a French-led international military intervention.

1920 capture of Damascus.headline: Zavzetje Damaska leta 1920
paragraphs: Zavzetje Damaska leta 1920 je bila zadnja faza francosko-sirske vojne, v kateri so francoske sile skoraj brez odpora zavzele Damask. Arabsko kraljestvo Sirija je bilo konec, začel je veljati francoski mandat za Sirijo. Kmalu zatem, septembra 1920, je Damask postal prestolnica države Damask pod francoskim mandatom.

Vojna Hašemitov proti Francozom, ki je izbruhnila januarja 1920, se je za novo razglašeno Arabsko kraljestvo Sirija kmalu sprevrgla v uničujoč pohod. Kralj Fejsal se je v skrbeh zaradi posledic dolgega krvavega boja s Francozi 14. julija 1920 sam vdal, a njegovo sporočilo ni prišlo do vojnega ministra Jusufa al Azme, ki je kralja prezrl in povedel vojsko k Majsalunu, da bi Sirijo branil pred francoskim prodorom. Bitka pri Majsalunu se je končala s porazom Sircev. Francoske čete so nato krenile nad Damask in ga 24. julija 1920 zavzele.

source.title: 1920 capture of Damascus
paragraphs: The 1920 capture of Damascus was the final stage of the Franco-Syrian War in which French forces captured Damascus with little resistance. The Arab Kingdom of Syria was brought to an end, and the French mandate of Syria was put into effect. Shortly afterward, in September 1920, Damascus was established as the capital of the State of Damascus under a French mandate.

The war of the Hashemites against the French, which erupted in January 1920, shortly became a devastating campaign for the newly-proclaimed Arab Kingdom of Syria. Worried about the results of a long bloody fight with the French, King Faisal himself surrendered on 14 July 1920, but his message would not reach War minister Yusuf al-'Azma, who, ignoring the King, led an army to Maysalun to defend Syria from the French advance. The Battle of Maysalun resulted in a crushing Syrian defeat. The French troops later marched on Damascus and captured it on 24 July 1920.

1921 Persian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Perziji leta 1921
paragraphs: Iranski državni udar leta 1921, v Iranu znan kot državni udar 3. esfanda 1299 (po perzijskem sončnem koledarju), označuje več velikih dogodkov v kadžarskem Iranu leta 1921, ki so nazadnje pripeljali do odstavitve dinastije Kadžarov in do tega, da je leta 1925 vladajoča rodbina Irana postala dinastija Pahlavijev.

Dogodki so se začeli 22. februarja 1921 z udarom perzijske kozaške brigade pod vodstvom Reze kana. Natančen obseg britanske vpletenosti v udar je še vedno predmet zgodovinske razprave, skoraj gotovo pa je Edmund Ironside zarotnikom svetoval. Z udarom je oblast prevzel Zia ol Din Tabatabai, ki je postal predsednik vlade. Udar je bil večinoma nekrvav in je naletel na malo odpora. Reza kan je z okrepljenimi silami in kozaško brigado uspešno vojaško odpravil separatistična in uporniška gibanja v Tabrizu, Mašhadu in gibanje Džangali v Gilanu. Pohod proti Simku in Kurdom je bil manj uspešen in je trajal globoko v leto 1922, čeprav se je nazadnje končal z iranskim uspehom.

source.title: 1921 Persian coup d'état
paragraphs: 1921 Iranian coup d'état, known in Iran as 3 Esfand 1299 coup d'état (Persian: کودتای ۳ اسفند ۱۲۹۹ with the Solar Persian date), refers to several major events in Qajar Iran in 1921, which eventually led to the deposition of the Qajar dynasty and the establishment of the Pahlavi dynasty as the ruling house of Iran in 1925.

The events began with a coup by the Persian Cossack Brigade headed by Reza Khan on 22 February 1921. The precise level of British involvement in the coup remains a matter of historical debate, but it is almost certain that Edmund Ironside provided advice to the plotters. With this coup Zia ol Din Tabatabaee took over power and became prime minister. The coup was largely bloodless and faced little resistance. With his expanded forces and the Cossack Brigade, Reza Khan launched successful military actions to eliminate separatist and dissident movements in Tabriz, Mashhad and the Jangalis in Gilan. The campaign against Simko and the Kurds was less successful and lasted well into 1922, though it eventually concluded with Iranian success.

1941 Iraqi coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Iraku leta 1941
paragraphs: Iraški državni udar leta 1941 (arabsko: Thawrah Rašīd ʿAlī al-Kaylānī), imenovan tudi udar Rašida Alija al Gajlanija ali udar zlatega kvadrata, je bil nacionalistični državni udar v Iraku 1. aprila 1941, ki je strmoglavil probritanski režim regenta Abd al Ilaha in njegovega predsednika vlade Nurija al Saida ter za regenta postavil Šarafa bin Radžeha, za predsednika vlade pa Rašida Alija al Gajlanija.

Udar so vodili štirje iraški nacionalistični generali, znani kot »zlati kvadrat«, ki so hoteli vojno izkoristiti za pritisk za popolno neodvisnost Iraka po omejeni neodvisnosti, pridobljeni leta 1932. Zato so sodelovali z nemško obveščevalno službo in sprejeli vojaško pomoč nacistične Nemčije in fašistične Italije. Menjava vlade je pripeljala do britanske invazije na Irak in zasedbe, ki je trajala do leta 1947.

source.title: 1941 Iraqi coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1941 Iraqi coup d'état (Arabic: ثورة رشيد علي الكيلاني, Thawrah Rašīd ʿAlī al-Kaylānī), also called the Rashid Ali Al-Gaylani coup or the Golden Square coup, was a nationalist coup d'état in Iraq on 1 April 1941 that overthrew the pro-British regime of Regent 'Abd al-Ilah and his Prime Minister Nuri al-Said and installed Sharaf bin Rajeh as Regent and Rashid Ali al-Gaylani as Prime Minister.

The coup was led by four Iraqi nationalist army generals, known as "the Golden Square", who intended to use the war to press for full Iraqi independence following the limited independence granted in 1932. To that end, they worked with German intelligence and accepted military assistance from Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy. The change in government led to the British invasion of Iraq and subsequent occupation until 1947.

1953 Iranian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Iranu leta 1953
paragraphs: Z državnim udarom 19. avgusta 1953 so strmoglavili iranskega predsednika vlade Mohameda Mosadeka in okrepili oblast iranskega šaha Mohameda Reze Pahlavija. Udar sta spodbudila Združeno kraljestvo (MI6) z operacijo Boot in Združene države (CIA) s projektom TP-AJAX oziroma operacijo Ajax. Ključni motiv je bila zaščita britanskih naftnih interesov v Iranu, potem ko je Mosadek leta 1951 nacionaliziral državno naftno industrijo.

source.title: 1953 Iranian coup d'état
paragraphs: On 19 August 1953 a coup d'état overthrew the Prime Minister of Iran, Mohammad Mosaddegh, strengthening the rule of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, the Shah of Iran. It was instigated by the United Kingdom (MI6), under the name Operation Boot and by the United States (CIA), under the name TP-AJAX Project or Operation Ajax. A key motive was to protect British oil-interests in Iran after Mosaddegh had nationalized the country's oil industry in 1951.

1959 Mosul uprising.headline: Vstaja v Mosulu leta 1959
paragraphs: Vstaja v Mosulu leta 1959 se je začela s poskusom državnega udara arabskih nacionalistov v Mosulu, ki so hoteli odstaviti tedanjega iraškega predsednika vlade Abdula Karima Kasima in postaviti arabsko nacionalistično vlado, ki bi Republiko Irak pridružila Združeni arabski republiki. Ko je udar spodletel, sta se v Mosulu sesula red in zakon: več dni so potekali nasilni ulični boji med skupinami, ki so skušale izkoristiti kaos za poravnavo političnih in osebnih računov.

source.title: 1959 Mosul uprising
paragraphs: The 1959 Mosul Uprising started with an attempted coup by Arab nationalists in Mosul who wished to depose the then Iraqi Prime Minister Abdul-Karim Qasim, and install an Arab nationalist government which would then join the Republic of Iraq with the United Arab Republic. Following the failure of the coup, law and order broke down in Mosul, which witnessed several days of violent street battles between various groups attempting to use the chaos to settle political and personal scores.

Sirski državni udar leta 1963, ki ga baatistično zgodovinopisje imenuje revolucija 8. marca (arabsko: ثورة الثامن من آذار), je bil prevzem oblasti v Siriji, ki ga je izvedel vojaški odbor sirske regionalne veje Arabske socialistične stranke Baath. Načrtovanje in izvedbo zarote sirskih baatistov je spodbudil prevzem oblasti stranke Baath v Iraku februarja 1963.

source.title: 1963 Syrian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1963 Syrian coup d'état, labelled in Ba'athist historiography as the March 8 Revolution (Arabic: ثورة الثامن من آذار), was the seizure of power in Syria by the military committee of the Syrian Regional Branch of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party. The planning and the unfolding conspiracy of the Syrian Ba'athist operatives were prompted by the Ba'ath party's seizure of power in Iraq in February 1963.

1966 Syrian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Siriji leta 1966
paragraphs: V sirskem državnem udaru leta 1966 (21.–23. februarja) so vlado Sirske arabske republike strmoglavili in zamenjali. Vladajoče narodno poveljstvo Arabske socialistične stranke Baath je z oblasti odstranila zveza strankinega vojaškega odbora in sirske regionalne veje pod vodstvom Salaha Džadida.

Udar je sprožil zaostreni boj za oblast med staro gardo stranke, ki so jo zastopali Michel Aflaq, Salah al Din al Bitar in Munif al Razaz, ter radikalnimi levičarskimi frakcijami, privrženkami neobaatističnega stališča. Privrženci stare garde v vojski so 21. februarja ukazali premestitev tekmecev. Dva dni pozneje je vojaški odbor, ki je podpiral radikalne levičarske frakcije, sprožil udar z nasilnimi boji v Alepu, Damasku, Dejr ez Zorju in Latakiji. Zgodovinski ustanovitelji stranke so po udaru pobegnili iz države in preostanek življenja preživeli v izgnanstvu.

source.title: 1966 Syrian coup d'état
paragraphs: In the 1966 Syrian coup d'état (21–23 February) the government of the Syrian Arab Republic was overthrown and replaced. The ruling National Command of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party were removed from power by a union of the party's Military Committee and the Syrian Regional Branch, under the leadership of Salah Jadid.

The coup was precipitated by a heightening in the power struggle between the party's old guard, represented by Michel Aflaq, Salah al-Din al-Bitar, and Munif al-Razzaz, and the radical leftist factions adhering to a Neo-Ba'athist position. On 21 February, supporters of the old guard in the army ordered the transfer of their rivals. Two days later, the Military Committee, backing the radical leftist factions, launched a coup that involved violent fighting in Aleppo, Damascus, Deir ez-Zor, and Latakia. As a result of the coup, the party's historical founders fled the country and spent the rest of their lives in exile.

1970 Syrian coup d'etat.headline: Državni udar v Siriji leta 1970
paragraphs: Sirski državni udar leta 1970, imenovan tudi popravna revolucija (arabsko: Thawrat al-Tashih) ali popravno gibanje (al-Ḥarakah at-Taṣḥīḥīyya), je bil nekrvav vojaški državni udar, ki ga je 13. novembra 1970 v Siriji vodil general Hafez al Asad. Asad je obljubil, da bo ohranil in izboljšal »nacionalno socialistično linijo« države in stranke Baath. Stranka je ideološko revidirala svoja stališča in se odrekla nauku Salaha Džadida o izvažanju revolucij. Nova doktrina je poudarjala poraz Izraela z razvojem sirske vojske ob podpori Sovjetske zveze.
Asad je baatistični Siriji vladal do smrti leta 2000, nasledil pa ga je sin Bašar al Asad, ki je vladal do propada svojega režima decembra 2024.

source.title: 1970 Syrian coup d'etat
paragraphs: The 1970 Syrian coup d'etat, also called the Corrective Revolution (Arabic: ثورة التصحيح, romanized: Thawrat al-Tashih) or the Corrective Movement (Arabic: الحركة التصحيحية, romanized: al-Ḥarakah at-Taṣḥīḥīyya), was a bloodless military coup d'état led by General Hafez al-Assad on 13 November 1970 in Syria. Assad promised to sustain and improve the "nationalist socialist line" of the state and the Ba'ath Party. The Ba'ath party adopted an ideological revision, absolving itself of Salah Jadid's doctrine of exporting revolutions. The new doctrine placed emphasis on defeating Israel, by developing the Syrian military with the support of the Soviet Union.
Assad would rule Ba'athist Syria until his death in 2000, after which he was succeeded by his son Bashar al-Assad who in turn ruled until the collapse of his regime in December 2024.

1973 Israeli raid in Lebanon.headline: Izraelski napad v Libanonu leta 1973
paragraphs: V noči z 9. na 10. april 1973 so enote za posebne naloge izraelskih obrambnih sil napadle več ciljev Palestinske osvobodilne organizacije (PLO) v Bejrutu in Sidonu v Libanonu. Napad, znan kot operacija Pomlad mladosti, na splošno šteje za del operacije Božja jeza, izraelskega povračila za pokol v Münchnu na poletnih olimpijskih igrah leta 1972.

Izraelski vojaki so na libanonske plaže prispeli z gliserji, spuščenimi z raketnih čolnov na odprtem morju. Agenti Mosada so jih na plažah pričakali z avtomobili, najetimi prejšnji dan, jih odpeljali do ciljev in pozneje nazaj na plaže, od koder so se umaknili.
Med operacijo so bili ubiti trije najvišji voditelji PLO, ki so jih presenetili doma, in drugi člani PLO. Umrlo je tudi več libanonskih varnostnikov in civilnih sosedov ter dva izraelska vojaka.

source.title: 1973 Israeli raid in Lebanon
paragraphs: On the night of April 9 and early morning of April 10, 1973, Israel Defense Forces special forces units attacked several Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) targets in Beirut and Sidon, Lebanon. The attack, known as Operation Spring of Youth, is generally considered to have been part of Operation Wrath of God, Israel's retaliation for the Munich massacre at the 1972 Summer Olympics.

The Israeli troops arrived at the Lebanese beaches on speedboats launched from missile boats offshore. Mossad agents awaited the forces on the beaches with cars rented the previous day, and then drove them to their targets and later back to the beaches for extraction.

During the operation, three of the highest-level PLO leaders, surprised at home, were killed, along with other PLO members. Several Lebanese security people and civilian neighbors were also killed, as were two of the Israeli soldiers.

1975 Algiers Agreement.headline: Alžirski sporazum leta 1975
paragraphs: Alžirski sporazum leta 1975, znan tudi kot alžirski sporazumi ali alžirska deklaracija, sta podpisala Iran in Irak, da bi rešila vse odprte ozemeljske spore ob iransko-iraški meji. Posredovala je Alžirija, sporazum pa je bil podlaga za nadaljnji dvostranski pogodbi, podpisani 13. junija 1975 in 26. decembra 1975. Ozemeljski spori so zadevali iraški Šat al Arab in iransko provinco Huzestan; Irak se je hotel pogajati, da bi končal iransko podporo tedanjemu kurdskemu uporu v Iraku, potem ko je bil v spopadu za Šat al Arab v letih 1974–1975 vojaško poražen. Iraška vlada je pogodbo 17. septembra 1980, kmalu po iranski revoluciji, zaradi nove vrste obmejnih spopadov med državama razveljavila. Z iraško invazijo na Iran 22. septembra 1980, ki je sprožila osemletno iransko-iraško vojno, je pogodba povsem prenehala veljati.

source.title: 1975 Algiers Agreement
paragraphs: The 1975 Algiers Agreement, also known as the Algiers Accords and the Algiers Declaration, was signed between Iran and Iraq to settle any outstanding territorial disputes along the Iran–Iraq border. Mediated by Algeria, it served as the basis for additional bilateral treaties signed on 13 June 1975 and 26 December 1975. The territorial disputes in question concerned Iraq's Shatt al-Arab and Iran's Khuzestan Province, and Iraq had wished to negotiate to end Iran's support for the then-ongoing Iraqi Kurdish rebellion after suffering a military defeat in the 1974–1975 Shatt al-Arab conflict. On 17 September 1980, shortly after the Iranian Revolution, the Iraqi government abrogated the treaty in light of another series of cross-border clashes between the two countries. On 22 September 1980, the treaty was completely voided with the Iraqi invasion of Iran, which triggered the eight-year-long Iran–Iraq War.

Južnolibanonski konflikt leta 1978, znan tudi kot prva izraelska invazija na Libanon, z izraelskim kodnim imenom operacija Litani, se je začel, ko je Izrael marca 1978 vdrl v južni Libanon do reke Litani. To je bil odgovor na pokol na obalni cesti pri Tel Avivu, ki so ga zagrešili palestinski borci s sedežem v Libanonu. V spopadu je umrlo od 1100 do 2000 Libanoncev in Palestincev ter 20 Izraelcev, od 100.000 do 250.000 ljudi pa je bilo v Libanonu notranje razseljenih. Izraelske obrambne sile so vojaško zmagale nad Palestinsko osvobodilno organizacijo (PLO), ki se je morala umakniti iz južnega Libanona, kar ji je onemogočilo napade na Izrael čez kopensko mejo z Libanonom. Varnostni svet Združenih narodov je po izbruhu sovražnosti 19. marca 1978 sprejel resoluciji 425 in 426, ki sta Izrael pozvali k takojšnjemu umiku čet iz Libanona in ustanovili začasne sile Združenih narodov v Libanonu (UNIFIL).
Izrael je leta 1982 drugič vdrl v Libanon.

source.title: 1978 South Lebanon conflict
paragraphs: The 1978 South Lebanon conflict, also known as the First Israeli invasion of Lebanon and codenamed Operation Litani by Israel, began when Israel invaded southern Lebanon up to the Litani River in March 1978. It was in response to the Coastal Road massacre near Tel Aviv by Palestinian militants based in Lebanon. The conflict resulted in the deaths of 1,100–2,000 Lebanese and Palestinians, 20 Israelis, and the internal displacement of 100,000 to 250,000 people in Lebanon. The Israel Defense Forces gained a military victory against the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) as the latter was forced to withdraw from southern Lebanon, preventing it from launching attacks on Israel from across its land border with Lebanon. In response to the outbreak of hostilities, the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 425 and Resolution 426 on 19 March 1978, which called on Israel to immediately withdraw its troops from Lebanon and established the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL).
Israel launched a second invasion of Lebanon in 1982.

Libanonska vojna leta 1982, imenovana tudi druga izraelska invazija na Libanon, se je začela 6. junija 1982, ko je Izrael vdrl v južni Libanon. Invaziji je sledila vrsta napadov in protinapadov med Palestinsko osvobodilno organizacijo (PLO), ki je delovala v južnem Libanonu, in izraelskimi obrambnimi silami (IDF), ki so zahtevali civilne žrtve na obeh straneh meje. Izraelska vojaška operacija s kodnim imenom Mir za Galilejo se je začela, potem ko so oboroženci Organizacije Abu Nidal poskušali umoriti Šloma Argova, izraelskega veleposlanika v Združenem kraljestvu. Izraelski premier Menahem Begin je za napad okrivil PLO in ga uporabil kot casus belli. Bila je druga izraelska invazija na Libanon, za južnolibanonskim konfliktom leta 1978.

source.title: 1982 Lebanon War
paragraphs: The 1982 Lebanon War, also called the Second Israeli invasion of Lebanon, began on 6 June 1982, when Israel invaded southern Lebanon. The invasion followed a series of attacks and counter-attacks between the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) operating in southern Lebanon and the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), which had caused civilian casualties on both sides of the border. The Israeli military operation, codenamed Operation Peace for Galilee, was launched after gunmen from the Abu Nidal Organization attempted to assassinate Shlomo Argov, Israel's ambassador to the United Kingdom. Israeli prime minister Menachem Begin blamed the PLO, using the incident as a casus belli. It was the second invasion of Lebanon by Israel, following the 1978 South Lebanon conflict.

Iraške vstaje leta 1991 so bile etnične in verske vstaje proti baatističnemu režimu Sadama Huseina, ki so jih vodili predvsem šiitski uporniki in Kurdi. Trajale so od marca do aprila 1991, po premirju ob koncu zalivske vojne. Večinoma neusklajeni upor je spodbujal vtis, da je iraški predsednik Sadam Husein postal ranljiv in da je zamenjava režima mogoča. Ta vtis šibkosti je bil v veliki meri posledica izida iransko-iraške in zalivske vojne, ki sta se zvrstili v enem samem desetletju in opustošili prebivalstvo in gospodarstvo Iraka.

source.title: 1991 Iraqi uprisings
paragraphs: The 1991 Iraqi uprisings were ethnic and religious uprisings against Saddam Hussein's Ba'athist regime that were mainly led by Shia rebels and Kurds. The uprisings lasted from March to April 1991 after a ceasefire following the end of the Gulf War. The mostly uncoordinated insurgency was fueled by the perception that Iraqi President Saddam Hussein had become vulnerable to regime change. This perception of weakness was largely the result of the outcome of the Iran–Iraq War and the Gulf War, both of which occurred within a single decade and devastated the population and economy of Iraq.

Invazija na Irak leta 2003 je bila prva faza iraške vojne. Začela se je 20. marca 2003 in trajala nekaj več kot mesec dni, od tega 26 dni velikih bojnih operacij. Izvedla jo je koalicija pod vodstvom Združenih držav, ki so jo sestavljali predvsem ameriški, britanski, avstralski in poljski vojaki.

Po besedah ameriškega predsednika Georgea W. Busha in britanskega premiera Tonyja Blaira je koalicija hotela Irak razorožiti orožja za množično uničevanje – jedrskega, kemičnega in biološkega – in »osvoboditi iraško ljudstvo« z odstavitvijo predsednika Sadama Huseina ter s tem končati njegovo »podporo terorizmu«. Inšpektorji Združenih narodov (OZN) pred invazijo v Iraku niso našli nobenih dokazov o iraškem orožju za množično uničevanje; ameriški in britanski uradniki so trdili, da je še vedno skrito in da neposredno ogroža svetovni mir.

source.title: 2003 invasion of Iraq
paragraphs: The 2003 invasion of Iraq was the first stage of the Iraq War. The invasion began on 20 March 2003 and lasted just over one month, including 26 days of major combat operations. The invasion was conducted by a United States–led coalition of mainly American, British, Australian, and Polish troops.

According to US president George W. Bush and UK prime minister Tony Blair, the coalition aimed to disarm Iraq of weapons of mass destruction (WMDs)—nuclear, chemical, and biological weapons—and "free the Iraqi people" by deposing president Saddam Hussein, in turn ending his "support for terrorism". Before the invasion, United Nations (UN) inspectors in Iraq had found no evidence of Iraqi WMDs; US and British officials claimed they were still hidden, and posed an immediate threat to world peace.

Libanonska vojna leta 2006 je bil 34-dnevni oboroženi spopad v Libanonu med Hezbolahom in Izraelom. Začela se je 12. julija 2006 in trajala, dokler ni zjutraj 14. avgusta 2006 začelo veljati premirje, ki so ga posredovali Združeni narodi; formalno se je končala 8. septembra 2006, ko je Izrael odpravil pomorsko blokado Libanona. Bila je tretja izraelska invazija na Libanon po letu 1978.

source.title: 2006 Lebanon War
paragraphs: The 2006 Lebanon War was a 34-day armed conflict in Lebanon, fought between Hezbollah and Israel. The war started on 12 July 2006 and continued until a United Nations-brokered ceasefire went into effect in the morning on 14 August 2006, though it formally ended on 8 September 2006 when Israel lifted its naval blockade of Lebanon. It marked the third Israeli invasion into Lebanon since 1978.

Zavarovane dežele Irana, splošno znane kot afšaridski Iran, afšaridska Perzija ali Afšaridski imperij, so bile iranski imperij, ki ga je ustanovilo turkmensko pleme Afšar v severovzhodni iranski provinci Horasan; dinastija Afšaridov je Iranu vladala sredi 18. stoletja. Njen ustanovitelj Nader šah je bil uspešen vojskovodja, ki je leta 1736 odstavil zadnjega pripadnika dinastije Safavidov in se razglasil za šaha.

Pod Nader šahom je Iran dosegel največji obseg od časov Sasanidskega imperija. Na vrhuncu je vladal današnjemu Iranu, Kavkazu, Afganistanu, Uzbekistanu in drugim delom Srednje Azije ter delom Arabije, indijske podceline, Iraka in Turčije. Po njegovi smrti so si večino imperija razdelili Zandi, Durani in Kalatski kanat, oblast Afšaridov pa se je skrčila na majhno krajevno državo v Horasanu. Dinastijo je leta 1796 dokončno strmoglavil Aga Mohamed kan Kadžar, ki je ustanovil Kadžarski imperij in znova vzpostavil iransko nadoblast nad prej izgubljenimi območji.

source.title: Afsharid Iran
paragraphs: The Guarded Domains of Iran, commonly referred to as Afsharid Iran, Afsharid Persia or the Afsharid Empire, was an Iranian empire established by the Turkoman Afshar tribe in Iran's north-eastern province of Khorasan, the Afsharid dynasty would rule over Iran during the mid 18th century. The dynasty's founder, Nader Shah, was a successful military commander who deposed the last member of the Safavid dynasty in 1736, and proclaimed himself Shah.

During Nader Shah's reign, Iran reached its greatest extent since the time of the Sasanian Empire. At its height it ruled modern-day Iran, the Caucasus, Afghanistan, Uzbekistan and other parts of Central Asia, as well as parts of Arabia, the Indian subcontinent, Iraq and Turkey. After his death, most of his empire was divided between the Zands, Durranis, and Khanate of Kalat, with Afsharid rule being confined to a small local state in Khorasan. The Afsharid dynasty was finally overthrown in 1796 by Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar, who founded the Qajar Empire and reestablished Iranian suzerainty over the previously lost regions.

Oaza Al Ahsa (arabsko: al-Ahsā), znana tudi kot al Hasa ali Hadžar, je oaza in zgodovinska pokrajina na vzhodu Savdske Arabije. Po njej se imenuje guvernorat Al Ahsa, ki obsega velik del Vzhodne province države. Oaza leži okoli 60 km v notranjosti od obale Perzijskega zaliva in jo sestavljajo štiri glavna mesta in 22 vasi. Med mesti sta Al Mubaraz in Al Hufuf, dve največji mesti v Savdski Arabiji.

source.title: Al-Ahsa Oasis
paragraphs: Al-Ahsa Oasis (Arabic: الْأَحْسَاء, al-ʾAhsā), also known as al-Ḥasāʾ (الْحَسَا) or Hajar (هَجَر), is an oasis and historical region in eastern Saudi Arabia. Al-Ahsa Governorate, which makes up much of the country's Eastern Province, is named after it. The oasis is located about 60 km (37 miles) inland from the coast of the Persian Gulf. Al-Ahsa Oasis comprises four main cities and 22 villages. The cities include Al-Mubarraz and Al-Hofuf, two of the largest cities in Saudi Arabia.

Alid dynasties of northern Iran.headline: Alidske dinastije severnega Irana
paragraphs: Alidske dinastije severnega Irana ali Alavidi (perzijsko: علویان طبرستان). V 9. in 10. stoletju so severnoiranske pokrajine Tabaristan, Dajlam in Gilan, stisnjene med Kaspijsko jezero in gorovje Alborz, prišle pod oblast več alidskih dinastij, privrženk zajdijske veje šiitskega islama.
Prvi in najmogočnejši zajdijski emirat so ustanovili v Tabaristanu leta 864 in je trajal do leta 928. Leta 900 ga je prekinila samanidska zasedba, leta 914 pa ga je obnovila druga alidska veja.

Drugo obdobje alidskega emirata so pestili notranji spori in boji za oblast med vejama, končalo pa se je leta 928 z drugo samanidsko osvojitvijo pokrajine. Nekateri alavidski vojaki in generali so nato prestopili k Samanidom, med njimi Mardavidž, ustanovitelj dinastije Zijaridov, in trije Bujini sinovi (Ali, Hasan in Ahmad), ustanovitelji dinastije Bujidov.

source.title: Alid dynasties of northern Iran
paragraphs: Alid dynasties of northern Iran or Alavids (Persian: علویان طبرستان). In the 9th–10th centuries, the northern Iranian regions of Tabaristan, Daylam and Gilan, sandwiched between the Caspian Sea and the Alborz range, came under the rule of a number of Alid dynasties, espousing the Zaydi branch of Shia Islam.
The first and most powerful Zaydi emirate was established in Tabaristan in 864 and lasted until 928. It was interrupted by Samanid occupation in 900, but restored in 914 by another Alid branch.

The second period of the Alid emirate was plagued by internal dissensions and power struggles between the two branches, and ended in the second conquest of the region by the Samanids in 928. Subsequently, some of the soldiers and generals of the Alavids joined the Samanids, among them Mardavij, founder of the Ziyarid dynasty, and the three sons of Buya (Ali, Hassan and Ahmad), founders of the Buyid dynasty.

Hašemitska arabska federacija je bila kratkotrajna konfederacija hašemitskih kraljevin Irak in Jordanija, ki je trajala od 14. februarja do 2. avgusta 1958. Čeprav ime nakazuje zvezno ureditev, je bila dejansko konfederacija.

Federacijo sta 14. februarja 1958 ustanovila iraški kralj Fejsal II. in njegov bratranec, jordanski kralj Husein, ki sta hotela kraljevini združiti v odgovor na nastanek Združene arabske republike Egipta in Sirije. Zveza je trajala le šest mesecev: Fejsala II. je 14. julija odstavil vojaški udar, nova iraška vlada pa je federacijo 2. avgusta 1958 uradno razpustila.

source.title: Arab Federation
paragraphs: The Hashemite Arab Federation was a short-lived confederation that lasted from 14 February to 2 August 1958, between the Hashemite kingdoms of Iraq and Jordan. Although the name implies a federal structure, it was de facto a confederation.

The Federation was formed on 14 February 1958, when King Faisal II of Iraq and his cousin, King Hussein of Jordan, sought to unite their two Hashemite kingdoms as a response to the formation of the United Arab Republic between Egypt and Syria. The union lasted only six months. Faisal II was deposed by a military coup on 14 July, and the new Iraqi government officially dissolved the Federation on 2 August 1958.

Arabski Irak (arabsko: ‘Irāq ul-‘Arab, dobesedno »Irak Arabcev«) je bil zgodovinski zemljepisni izraz, s katerim so srednjeveški in zgodnjenovoveški pisci označevali pokrajino Irak v Mezopotamiji, pogosto s središčem v spodnji Mezopotamiji. Njegov natančni obseg se je razlikoval glede na pisca in obdobje, nekateri viri pa ga opisujejo kot ozemlje, ki se v grobem ujema z velikim delom današnjega Iraka.

Izraz »arabski Irak« (perzijsko: Irâq-e Arab) se je razširil v seldžuškem obdobju (11.–12. stoletje), da bi zgodovinsko pokrajino Mezopotamijo (pravi Irak) ločili od »perzijskega Iraka« (Irâq-e Ajam), pokrajine, ki so jo prej imenovali al Džibal in je bila povezana z zgodovinsko pokrajino Medijo. Perzijski in arabski Irak so skupaj pogosto imenovali »al Irakajn«, »oba Iraka«. Gorata ozemlja med njima, Kurdistan, Luristan in Bahtiari, so glede na vojaške razmere lahko pripadala enemu ali drugemu, a so ne glede na to pogosto ohranjala veliko samostojnost.

source.title: Arab Iraq
paragraphs: Arab Iraq or Arabian Iraq (Arabic: عراق العرب, romanized: ‘Irāq ul-‘Arab, lit. 'Iraq of the Arabs') was a historical geographical term used by medieval and early modern writers for the region of Iraq in Mesopotamia, often centered in Lower Mesopotamia. Its precise extent varied by author and period, and some sources describe Arab Iraq as corresponding roughly to much of modern Iraq.

The term "Arab Iraq" (Persian: عراق عرب, romanized: Irâq-e Arab) became commonly used in the Seljuk period (11th–12th centuries) as a way to distinguish the historical region of Mesopotamia (Iraq proper) from "Persian Iraq" (Persian: عراق عجم, romanized: Irâq-e Ajam), a region previously referred to as al-Jibal, associated with the historical region of Media. Persian Iraq and Arab Iraq were often referred to as "al-Iraqayn" (Arabic: العراقين) meaning "the two Iraqs" collectively. The mountainous territories between them, comprising Kurdistan, Luristan, and Bakhtiyari, could have fell under either region depending on the military situation, but often maintained a high degree of autonomy regardless.

Arabska socialistična stranka Baath – regija Sirija (arabsko: Ḥizb al-Ba'th al-'Arabī al-Ishtirākī – Quṭr Sūriyā), uradno sirska regionalna veja, je bila baatistična organizacija, ki so jo 7. aprila 1947 ustanovili Michel Aflaq, Salah al Din al Bitar in privrženci Zakija al Arsuzija. Stranka je Sirijo vodila od državnega udara leta 1963, ki je baatiste pripeljal na oblast, do 8. decembra 2024, ko je Bašar al Asad pred uporniško ofenzivo, ki je končala sirsko državljansko vojno, pobegnil iz Damaska. Formalno so jo razpustili januarja 2025.

source.title: Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Syria Region
paragraphs: The Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Syria Region (Arabic: حزب البعث العربي الاشتراكي – قطر سوريا Ḥizb al-Ba'th al-'Arabī al-Ishtirākī – Quṭr Sūriyā), officially the Syrian Regional Branch (Arabic: الفرع القطري السوري), was a Ba'athist organisation founded on 7 April 1947 by Michel Aflaq, Salah al-Din al-Bitar and followers of Zaki al-Arsuzi. The party ruled Syria from the 1963 coup d'état, which brought the Ba'athists to power, until 8 December 2024, when Bashar al-Assad fled Damascus in the face of a rebel offensive which concluded the Syrian civil war. It was formally disbanded in January 2025.

Assyrian conquest of Egypt.headline: Asirska osvojitev Egipta
paragraphs: Asirska osvojitev Egipta je zajela razmeroma kratko obdobje Novoasirskega cesarstva, od leta 673 do 663 pr. n. št. Asirci si niso le podredili dežele z velikim kulturnim ugledom, temveč so z osvojitvijo Egipta cesarstvu dali tudi največji obseg.

source.title: Assyrian conquest of Egypt
paragraphs: The Assyrian conquest of Egypt covered a relatively short period of the Neo-Assyrian Empire from 673 to 663 BCE. The conquest of Egypt not only placed a land of great cultural prestige under Assyrian rule but also brought the Neo-Assyrian Empire to its greatest extent.

Chobanids.headline: Čobanidi
paragraphs: Čobanidi ali Čupanidi (perzijsko: چوپانیان) so bili potomci mongolske družine iz klana Suldus, ki se je v Perziji uveljavila v 14. stoletju. Sprva so služili Ilkanom, po padcu Ilkanata pa so dejansko prevzeli oblast nad ozemljem. Vladali so Azerbajdžanu (kjer so imeli sedež), Aranu, delom Male Azije, Mezopotamiji in zahodni osrednji Perziji, Bagdad pa so prevzeli Džalairidi.

source.title: Chobanids
paragraphs: The Chobanids or the Chupanids (Persian: چوپانیان) were descendants of a Mongol family of the Suldus clan that came to prominence in 14th century Persia. At first serving under the Ilkhans, they took de facto control of the territory after the fall of the Ilkhanate. The Chobanids ruled over Azerbaijan (where they were based), Arrān, parts of Asia Minor, Mesopotamia, and west central Persia, while the Jalayirids took control in Baghdad.

Prva savdska država (arabsko: ad-dawla as-suʿūdiyya al-ʾūlā), uradno Emirat Dirija (ʾimāra ad-dirʿiyya), je bila politična tvorba na Arabskem polotoku, ki je obstajala med letoma 1744 in 1818. Emir nedždskega mesta Dirija Mohamed bin Saud Al Mukrin in verski voditelj Mohamed ibn Abd al Vahab sta podpisala pakt, s katerim sta ustanovila družbeno-versko reformno gibanje, ki je pod političnim vodstvom rodbine Saud širilo vahabitski verski nauk.

Državo so nato razširili po Arabskem polotoku, Levantu, do obale iranskega mesta Bandar Abas in do ožine Bab el Mandeb. Prva savdska država se je končala leta 1818, ko so egiptovske sile po večmesečnem obleganju zavzele in porušile prestolnico Dirijo.

source.title: First Saudi state
paragraphs: The first Saudi state (Arabic: الدَّوْلَةُ السُّعُودِيَّةُ الْأُولَىٰ, romanized: ad-dawla as-suʿūdiyya al-ʾūlā), officially the Emirate of Diriyah (Arabic: إمارة الدرعية, romanized: ʾimāra ad-dirʿiyya), was a polity that existed on the Arabian Peninsula between 1744 and 1818. The emir of a Najdi town called Diriyah, Muhammad bin Saud Al Muqrin, and the religious leader Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab signed a pact founding a socio-religious reform movement that propagated the Wahhabi religious doctrine under the political leadership of the House of Saud.

They then proceeded to expand their state throughout the Arabian Peninsula, the Levant, the coast of the Iranian city of Bandar Abbas, and the Bab al-Mandab Strait. The first Saudi state ended in 1818 after the Egyptian forces captured and destroyed the Capital town of Diriyah following a siege that lasted for several months.

Emirate of Jabal Shammar.headline: Emirat Džabal Šamar
paragraphs: Emirat Džabal Šamar (arabsko: Imārah Jabal Shammar), znan tudi kot Emirat Hail ali Rašidski emirat, je bil država na severu Arabskega polotoka, vključno z Nedždom, ki je obstajala od sredine 19. stoletja do leta 1921. Šamar je bil zveza plemen na Arabskem polotoku, ime Džabal Šamar pa pomeni »Šamarjeva gora«. Prestolnica je bil Hail, vladala pa je monarhija dinastije Rašidov. Obsegal je dele današnje Savdske Arabije, Iraka in Jordanije.

source.title: Emirate of Jabal Shammar
paragraphs: The Emirate of Jabal Shammar (Arabic: إِمَارَة جَبَل شَمَّر, romanized: Imārah Jabal Shammar), also known as the Emirate of Haʾil (إِمَارَة حَائِل) or the Rashidi Emirate (إِمَارَة آل رَشِيْد), was a state in the northern part of the Arabian Peninsula, including Najd, existing from the mid-nineteenth century to 1921. Shammar had been a confederation in the Arabian Peninsula. Jabal Shammar in English is translated as the "Mountain of Shammar". Jabal Shammar's capital was Ha'il. It was led by the monarchy of the Rashidi dynasty. It included parts of modern-day Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and Jordan.

Druga savdska država (arabsko: ad-Dawla as-Suʿūdiyya ath-Thāniyya), uradno Emirat Nedžd, je bila država, ki je med letoma 1824 in 1891 obstajala v pokrajini Nedžd na ozemlju današnje Savdske Arabije. Savdska oblast se je vrnila v osrednjo (Nedžd) in vzhodno Arabijo, potem ko je prvo savdsko državo v osmansko-vahabitski vojni strmoglavil egiptovski ejalet Osmanskega cesarstva.

Za drugo savdsko obdobje so bili značilni manjše ozemeljsko širjenje in manjša verska vnema, čeprav so se savdski voditelji še naprej imenovali imami in so še vedno zaposlovali vahabitske verske učenjake. Za začetek druge savdske države navadno velja Turki bin Abdulah, ki je leta 1824 osmansko-egiptovskim silam znova odvzel Rijad. Hudi notranji spori v rodbini Saud so dinastijo nazadnje pokopali v bitki pri Mulajdi leta 1891 med silami, zvestimi zadnjemu savdskemu imamu Abdulu Rahmanu bin Fejsalu, in dinastijo Rašidov iz Haila.

source.title: Second Saudi state
paragraphs: The second Saudi state (Arabic: الدَّوْلَةُ السُّعُودِيَّةُ الثَّانِيَةُ, romanized: ad-Dawla as-Suʿūdiyya ath-Thāniyya), officially known as the Emirate of Najd, was a state that existed between 1824 and 1891 in the Najd region of what is now Saudi Arabia. Saudi rule was restored to central (Najd) and Eastern Arabia after the first Saudi state having previously been brought down by the Ottoman Empire's Egypt Eyalet in the Ottoman–Wahhabi War.

The second Saudi period was marked by less territorial expansion and less religious zeal, although the Saudi leaders continued to be called Imam and still employed Wahhabist religious scholars. Turki bin Abdullah's reconquest of Riyadh from Ottoman-Egyptians forces in 1824 is generally regarded as the beginning of the second Saudi state. Severe internal conflicts within the House of Saud eventually led to the dynasty's downfall at the Battle of Mulayda in 1891, between the forces loyal to the last Saudi imam, Abdul Rahman bin Faisal, and the Rashidi dynasty of Hail.

First Sealand dynasty.headline: Prva dinastija Morske dežele
paragraphs: Prva dinastija Morske dežele (URU.KÙKI) ali 2. babilonska dinastija (čeprav je bila neodvisna od Babilona, ki so mu vladali Amoriti), zelo okvirno datirana v ok. 1732–1475 pr. n. št. (po srednji kronologiji), je skrivnostno zaporedje kraljev, ki ga izpričujejo predvsem jedrnate omembe na seznamih kraljev A in B ter sočasni zapisi na asirskem sinhronističnem seznamu kraljev A.117. Sprva so jo imenovali »dinastija Dežele morja«, pozneje pa se je uveljavilo ime Morska dežela.

Dinastija, ki se je odtrgala od starobabilonskega cesarstva, je dobila ime po provinci na skrajnem jugu Mezopotamije, močvirni pokrajini brez velikih naselij, ki se je z zasipavanjem ustij Tigrisa in Evfrata postopoma širila proti jugu (v železni dobi znani kot mat Kaldi, »Kaldeja«). Lončenino Morske dežele so našli v Girsuju, Uruku in Lagašu, severneje pa na nobenem najdišču.

source.title: First Sealand dynasty
paragraphs: The First Sealand dynasty (URU.KÙKI), or the 2nd Dynasty of Babylon (although it was independent of Amorite-ruled Babylon), very speculatively c. 1732–1475 BC (MC), is an enigmatic series of kings attested to primarily in laconic references in the King Lists A and B, and as contemporaries recorded on the Assyrian Synchronistic king list A.117. Initially it was named the "Dynasty of the Country of the Sea" with Sealand later becoming customary.

The dynasty, which had broken free of the Old Babylonian Empire, was named for the province in the far south of Mesopotamia, a swampy region bereft of large settlements which gradually expanded southwards with the silting up of the mouths of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers (the region known as mat Kaldi "Chaldaea" in the Iron Age). Sealand pottery has been found at Girsu, Uruk, and Lagash but in no site north of that.

Gaznavidski imperij (perzijsko: Ġaznaviyān) je bil kulturno perzijsko oblikovana sunitska muslimanska država turškega karluškega izvora. Cvetel je od leta 977 do 1186 in na vrhuncu segal od Oksa do doline Inda. Dinastijo je ustanovil Sabuktigin, ko je po smrti tasta Alp Tigina, nekdanjega generala Samanidskega imperija iz Balha, prevzel oblast v Gazni.

Sabuktiginov sin Mahmud iz Gazne je imperij razširil na vzhodu do Amudarje, Inda in Indijskega oceana, na zahodu pa do Reja in Hamadana. Pod Masudom I. je dinastija po bitki pri Dandanakanu leta 1040 začela izgubljati zahodna ozemlja v korist Seldžuškega imperija, zato se je njena posest skrčila na današnji Afganistan, Pakistan in severno Indijo.

source.title: Ghaznavid Empire
paragraphs: The Ghaznavid Empire (Persian: غزنویان, romanized: Ġaznaviyān) was a culturally Persianate, Sunni Muslim state of Turkic Karluk origin. Flourishing from 977 to 1186, the empire spread from the Oxus to the Indus Valley at its greatest extent. The dynasty was founded by Sabuktigin upon his succession to the rule of Ghazna after the death of his father-in-law, Alp Tigin, who was an ex-general of the Samanid Empire from Balkh.

Sabuktigin's son, Mahmud of Ghazni, expanded the Ghaznavid Empire to the Amu Darya, the Indus River and the Indian Ocean in the east and to Rey and Hamadan in the west. Under the reign of Mas'ud I, the Ghaznavid dynasty began losing control over its western territories to the Seljuk Empire after the Battle of Dandanaqan in 1040, resulting in a restriction of its holdings to modern-day Afghanistan, Pakistan and Northern India.

Gutian rule in Mesopotamia.headline: Gutejska vladavina v Mezopotamiji
paragraphs: Gutejska dinastija (sumersko: gu-ti-umKI) je bila vrsta kraljev iz ljudstva Gutejcev. Nekoč so menili, da so bili Gutejci horda, ki je pridrla v Mezopotamijo in strmoglavila akadsko in sumersko oblast, danes pa vemo, da so bili tedaj na tem območju že najmanj stoletje. Do konca akadskega obdobja so Gutejci zasedli sumersko mesto Adab in ga naredili za svojo prestolnico. Gutejska dinastija je prišla na oblast v Mezopotamiji proti koncu 3. tisočletja pr. n. št., po zatonu in propadu Akadskega imperija. Koliko časa so gutejski kralji vladali Mezopotamiji, ni gotovo, ocene pa segajo od nekaj let do stoletja. Konec dinastije zaznamuje vzpon uruškega vladarja Utu-hengala (ok. 2119–2112 pr. n. št.), s katerim se začne kratkotrajna »peta uruška dinastija«, za njim pa urskega vladarja Ur-Namuja (ok. 2112–2094 pr. n. št.), ustanovitelja tretje urske dinastije.

source.title: Gutian rule in Mesopotamia
paragraphs: The Gutian dynasty (Sumerian: 𒄖𒋾𒌝𒆠, gu-ti-umKI) was a line of kings, originating among the Gutian people. Originally thought to be a horde that swept in and brought down Akkadian and Sumerian rule in Mesopotamia, the Gutians are now known to have been in the area for at least a century by then. By the end of the Akkadian period, the Sumerian city of Adab was occupied by the Gutians, who made it their capital. The Gutian dynasty came to power in Mesopotamia near the end of the 3rd millennium BC, after the decline and fall of the Akkadian Empire. How long Gutian kings held rulership over Mesopotamia is uncertain, with estimates ranging from a few years up to a century. The end of the Gutian dynasty is marked by the accession of Uruk ruler Utu-hengal (c. 2119 - 2112 BC), marking the short-lived "Fifth dynasty of Uruk", followed by Ur ruler Ur-Nammu (c. 2112 – 2094 BC), founder of the Third Dynasty of Ur.

History of Egypt under the Muhammad Ali.headline: Egipt pod dinastijo Mohameda Alija
paragraphs: Zgodovina Egipta pod dinastijo Mohameda Alija (1805–1953) zajema poznejše obdobje osmanskega Egipta, egiptovski kedivat pod britansko zasedbo ter navidezno neodvisna Egiptovski sultanat in Kraljevino Egipt, konča pa se z revolucijo leta 1952 in nastankom Republike Egipt.

source.title: History of Egypt under the Muhammad Ali dynasty
paragraphs: The history of Egypt under the Muhammad Ali dynasty (1805–1953) spanned the later period of Ottoman Egypt, the Khedivate of Egypt under British occupation, and the nominally independent Sultanate of Egypt and Kingdom of Egypt, ending with the Revolution of 1952 and the formation of the Republic of Egypt.

History of Qatar.headline: Zgodovina Katarja
paragraphs: Zgodovina Katarja sega od prve človeške naselitve do nastanka sodobne države. Ljudje so v Katarju živeli že pred 50.000 leti, na Arabskem polotoku pa so izkopali kamenodobne tabore in orodje. Prva civilizacija, ki je bila na tem območju navzoča v neolitiku, je bila mezopotamska, kar dokazujejo najdbe črepinj iz obdobja Ubaid ob obalnih taborih.

source.title: History of Qatar
paragraphs: The history of Qatar spans from its first duration of human occupation to its formation as a modern state. Human occupation of Qatar dates back 50,000 years, and Stone Age encampments and tools have been unearthed in the Arabian Peninsula. Mesopotamia was the first civilization to have a presence in the area during the Neolithic period, evidenced by the discovery of potsherds originating from the Ubaid period near coastal encampments.

Zgodovina Sumerije zajema obdobje od poznega 5. do 3. tisočletja pr. n. št. v južni Mezopotamiji in priča o prvem prehodu na svetu od neolitskega vaškega življenja k zapleteni mestni civilizaciji. Razvoj je pospešila »monumentalizacija svetega«: skromna obredna svetišča, zlasti v Eriduju, so prerasla v ogromne templjeve komplekse, ki so delovali kot »sveti magneti«. Ta središča so pokrajino vlekla k sebi in sprožila »mestno implozijo«, ki je prebivalstvo zgostila v prvih pravih velemestih, kot je bil Uruk.

source.title: History of Sumer
paragraphs: The history of Sumer spans the late fifth to the third millennium BC in southern Mesopotamia, documenting the world's first transition from Neolithic village life to a complex urban civilization. This development was catalyzed by the "monumentalization of the sacred," a process where modest ritual shrines—most notably at Eridu—evolved into massive temple complexes that functioned as "sacred magnets." These centers exerted a centripetal force on the landscape, triggering an "urban implosion" that concentrated populations into the first true metropolises, such as Uruk.

Hotak dynasty.headline: Dinastija Hotaki
paragraphs: Imperij Hotaki (paštunsko: د هوتکيانو ټولواکمني; perzijsko: امپراتوری هوتکیان) je bila afganistanska dinastija paštunskih Gildžijev, ki je v 1720. letih za kratek čas vladala delom Irana in Afganistana. Leta 1709 jo je ustanovil Mirvais Hotak, ki je vodil uspešen upor proti propadajočemu perzijskemu Safavidskemu imperiju v pokrajini Loj Kandahar (»Veliki Kandahar«) na jugu današnjega Afganistana.

source.title: Hotak dynasty
paragraphs: The Hotak Empire (Pashto: د هوتکيانو ټولواکمني; Persian: امپراتوری هوتکیان) also known as the Hotaki Empire was an Afghan dynasty founded by Ghilji Pashtuns that briefly ruled parts of Iran and Afghanistan during the 1720s. It was established in 1709 by Mirwais Hotak, who led a successful rebellion against the declining Persian Safavid empire in the region of Loy Kandahar ("Greater Kandahar") in what is now southern Afghanistan.

Rodbina Al Kalifa (arabsko: Āl Khalīfah) je vladajoča družina Kraljevine Bahrajn. Pripada malikitski pravni šoli sunitskega islama in plemenu Aneza. Nekateri člani plemena so se pridružili zavezništvu Utub, ki se je iz Nedžda v osrednji Arabiji preselilo v Kuvajt, nato pa vladalo vsemu Katarju, natančneje Al Zubari, ki so jo zgradili in ji vladali, preden so leta 1783 osvojili Bahrajn. Družina Al Kalifa je zatirala domorodno prebivalstvo Baharna v Bahrajnu.

Družina danes vodi avtoritarni režim, v katerem so politične in državljanske svoboščine močno omejene. Njen sedanji poglavar je kralj Hamad bin Isa Al Kalifa, ki je leta 1999 postal bahrajnski emir, leta 2002 pa se je razglasil za kralja Bahrajna in tako dejansko postal ustavni monarh.
Leta 2025 je bila približno polovica ministrov bahrajnske vlade iz kraljeve družine Al Kalifa, iz nje pa je tudi predsednik vlade Salman bin Hamad Al Kalifa, sin sedanjega kralja.

source.title: House of Khalifa
paragraphs: The House of Khalifa (Arabic: آل خليفة, romanized: Āl Khalīfah) is the ruling family of the Kingdom of Bahrain. They follow the Maliki school of Sunni Islam and belong to the Anizah tribe. Some members of this tribe joined the Utub alliance which migrated from Najd in central Arabia to Kuwait, then ruled all of Qatar, more specifically Al Zubarah, which they built and ruled over before conquering Bahrain in 1783. The Khalifa family repressed the indigenous Baharna population in Bahrain.

The family currently heads an authoritarian regime where political and civil freedoms are substantially curtailed. The current head of the family is King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa, who became the Emir of Bahrain in 1999 and proclaimed himself King of Bahrain in 2002, in fact becoming a constitutional monarch.

As of 2025, roughly half of the serving cabinet ministers of Bahrain were members of the Al Khalifa royal family, while the country's Prime Minister, Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa, is also from the Al Khalifa family and is the son of the current King.

Iberska unija ali hispanska monarhija označuje obdobje od leta 1580 do 1640, ko je španska monarhija pod habsburško dinastijo, tedaj personalna unija kron Kastilje in Aragona, v personalno unijo pritegnila še Kraljevino Portugalsko. Pod španskimi habsburškimi vladarji Filipom II., Filipom III. in Filipom IV. je obsegala ves Iberski polotok razen Andore in francoskega ozemlja ter portugalske in španske čezmorske posesti. Unija se je začela po portugalski nasledstveni krizi leta 1580 in vojni za portugalsko nasledstvo, ki je sledila, trajala pa je do portugalske restavracijske vojne, v kateri je z razglasitvijo Ivana IV. za novega portugalskega kralja na oblast prišla nova vladajoča dinastija, rodbina Braganza.

source.title: Iberian Union
paragraphs: The Iberian Union, or the Hispanic Monarchy, describes the period from 1580 to 1640 in which the Monarchy of Spain under the Habsburg dynasty, then the personal union of the crowns of Castile and Aragon, brought in personal union also the Kingdom of Portugal. It incorporated the entire Iberian Peninsula, except Andorra and French territory, as well as Portuguese and Spanish overseas possessions, under the Spanish Habsburg monarchs Philip II, Philip III, and Philip IV. The union began after the Portuguese succession crisis of 1580 and the ensuing War of the Portuguese Succession, and lasted until the Portuguese Restoration War, during which the House of Braganza was established as Portugal's new ruling dynasty with the acclamation of John IV as the new king of Portugal.

Jemenski imami, pozneje tudi jemenski kralji, so bili verski voditelji (imami) zajdijske veje šiitskega islama. Od leta 897 so v delih Jemna vzpostavili preplet verske in posvetne politične oblasti. Njihov imamat se je v spreminjajočih se okoliščinah ohranil do konca severnojemenske državljanske vojne leta 1970, ki je sledila republikanski revoluciji leta 1962. Zajdijska teologija se od ismailizma in dvanajstniškega šiizma razlikuje po tem, da poudarja navzočnost dejavnega in vidnega imama kot voditelja. Od imama so pričakovali, da je podkovan v verskih vedah in se izkaže kot vreden voditelj skupnosti, če je bilo treba, tudi v boju. Kdor se je potegoval za imamat, je razglasil »poziv« (dava), in ni bilo redko, da je bilo kandidatov več.

source.title: Imams of Yemen
paragraphs: The Imams of Yemen, later also titled the Kings of Yemen, were religiously consecrated leaders (imams) belonging to the Zaydi branch of Shia Islam. They established a blend of religious and temporal-political rule in parts of Yemen from 897. Their imamate endured under varying circumstances until the end of the North Yemen civil war in 1970, following the republican revolution in 1962. Zaydi theology differs from Isma'ilism and Twelver Shi'ism by stressing the presence of an active and visible imam as leader. The imam was expected to be knowledgeable in religious scholarship, and to prove himself a worthy headman of the community, even in battle if this was necessary. A claimant of the imamate would proclaim a "call" (dawah), and there were not infrequently more than one claimant.

Indoskiti, znani tudi kot Indosaki, so bili nomadsko ljudstvo iranskega skitskega izvora, ki se je iz Srednje Azije preselilo proti jugu na območje današnjega Afganistana, vzhodnega Irana in severozahodne indijske podceline (današnji Pakistan in severna Indija). Selitve so trajale od sredine 2. stoletja pr. n. št. do 4. stoletja n. št.

source.title: Indo-Scythian Kingdom
paragraphs: The Indo-Scythians, also known as Indo-Sakas, were a group of nomadic people of Iranic Scythian origin who migrated from Central Asia southward into the present-day regions of Afghanistan, eastern Iran and the northwestern Indian subcontinent (present-day Pakistan and northern India). The migrations persisted from the middle of the second century BCE to the fourth century CE.

Injuids.headline: Indžuidi
paragraphs: Indžuidi (perzijsko: اینجویان), tudi Indžu ali rodbina Indžu, so bili iranska dinastija perzijskega izvora, ki je v 14. stoletju zavladala mestoma Širaz in Isfahan. Po razpadu Ilkanata so njeni člani postali dejansko neodvisni vladarji, dokler jih leta 1357 niso porazili Muzafaridi.

source.title: Injuids
paragraphs: The Injuids (Persian: اینجویان), also Injus or House of Inju, were an Iranian dynasty of Persian origin that came to rule over the cities of Shiraz and Isfahan during the 14th century. Its members became de facto independent rulers following the breakup of the Ilkhanate until their defeat in 1357 against the Muzaffarids.

Jalayirid Sultanate.headline: Džalairidski sultanat
paragraphs: Džalairidski sultanat (perzijsko: Jalāyiriyān), imenovan tudi dinastija Ilka ali Ilkanidi, je bila mongolska dinastija, ki je po razpadu Ilkanata v 1330. letih vladala današnjemu Iraku in zahodnemu Iranu. Širila se je okoli petdeset let, dokler je niso zaustavili Timurjeva osvajanja in upori turkmenskih Kara Kojunlujev. Po Timurjevi smrti leta 1405 so sultanat za kratek čas skušali obnoviti v južnem Iraku in Huzestanu, Kara Kojunluji pa so Džalairide dokončno odpravili leta 1432.

source.title: Jalayirid Sultanate
paragraphs: The Jalayirid Sultanate (Persian: جلایریان, romanized: Jalāyiriyān), also Ilka dynasty or Ilkanids, was a Mongol dynasty which ruled over modern-day Iraq and western Iran after the breakup of the Ilkhanate in the 1330s. It expanded for about fifty years, until disrupted by Timur's conquests and the revolts of the Qara Qoyunlu Turkoman. After Timur's death in 1405, there was a brief attempt to re-establish the sultanate in southern Iraq and Khuzistan. The Jalayirids were finally eliminated by the Qara Qoyunlu in 1432.

Kart dynasty.headline: Dinastija Kart
paragraphs: Dinastija Kart ali Kartidi (perzijsko: آل کرت) je bila sunitska muslimanska dinastija tadžiškega izvora, tesno povezana z Guridi, ki je v 13. in 14. stoletju vladala velikemu delu Horasana. Vladali so iz prestolnice Herat in iz Bamjana v osrednjem Horasanu, sprva kot podložniki sultana Guridskega imperija Gijas ad Dina Mohameda bin Sama, s katerim so bili v sorodu, nato pa kot vazalni knezi v Mongolskem imperiju. Ko je Ilkanat leta 1335 razpadel, je Muiz ad Din Husein ibn Gijas ad Din skušal svojo kneževino razširiti. Huseinova smrt leta 1370 in Timurjev vdor leta 1381 sta končala ambicije dinastije.

source.title: Kart dynasty
paragraphs: The Kart dynasty, also known as the Kartids (Persian: آل کرت), was a Sunni Muslim dynasty of Tajik origin, closely related to the Ghurids, that ruled over a large part of Khorasan during the 13th and 14th centuries. Ruling from their capital at Herat and central Khorasan in the Bamyan, they were at first subordinates of Sultan Abul-Fateh Ghiyāṣ-ud-din Muhammad bin Sām, Sultan of the Ghurid Empire, to whom they were related, and then as vassal princes within the Mongol Empire. Upon the fragmentation of the Ilkhanate in 1335, Mu'izz-uddin Husayn ibn Ghiyath-uddin worked to expand his principality. The death of Husayn b. Ghiyath-uddin in 1370 and the invasion of Timur in 1381, ended the Kart dynasty's ambitions.

Egiptovski kedivat je bil samostojna tributarna država Osmanskega cesarstva, ki so jo ustanovili in ji vladali pripadniki dinastije Mohameda Alija. Po porazu in izgonu Napoleonovih sil iz Egipta leta 1801 in po vzhodni krizi leta 1840 so Mohamed Ali in njegovi nasledniki osmanskemu Egiptu že vladali z veliko samostojnostjo. Leta 1867 je osmanski sultan vnuku Mohameda Alija, Ismail paši (vladal 1863–1879), podelil naziv kediva skupaj s skoraj popolno samostojnostjo v notranjih zadevah, nekaterimi diplomatskimi privilegiji in pravico do določanja nasledstva.

source.title: Khedivate of Egypt
paragraphs: The Khedivate of Egypt was an autonomous tributary state of the Ottoman Empire established and ruled by members of the dynasty of Muhammad Ali. Following the defeat and expulsion of Napoleon's forces from Egypt in 1801, and then the Oriental Crisis of 1840, Muhammad Ali and his successors had already ruled Ottoman Egypt with a significant degree of autonomy. In 1867, the Ottoman sultan granted Muhammad Ali's grandson, Isma'il Pasha (r. 1863–1879), the title of Khedive along with near-total autonomy over internal affairs, certain diplomatic privileges, and the order of succession.

Kraljevina Egipt (arabsko: Al-Mamlaka Al-Miṣriyya, dobesedno »Egiptovsko kraljestvo«) je bila pravna oblika egiptovske države v zadnjem obdobju vladavine dinastije Mohameda Alija, od leta 1922, ko je Združeno kraljestvo priznalo egiptovsko neodvisnost, do odprave monarhije Egipta in Sudana leta 1953 po egiptovski revoluciji leta 1952. Do angleško-egiptovske pogodbe leta 1936 je bila kraljevina neodvisna le navidezno, saj je Združeno kraljestvo obdržalo nadzor nad zunanjimi odnosi, komunikacijami, vojsko in ozemljem Angleško-egiptovskega Sudana. Uradno je bil Sudan kondominij obeh držav, v resnici pa je imelo oblast v Sudanu Združeno kraljestvo. Med letoma 1936 in 1953 so Britanci v zmanjšanem obsegu ohranili vojaško navzočnost ob Sueškem prekopu in vpliv na politične svetovalce Egipta.

source.title: Kingdom of Egypt
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Egypt (Arabic: المملكة المصرية, romanized: Al-Mamlaka Al-Miṣriyya, lit. 'The Egyptian Kingdom') was the legal form of the Egyptian state during the latter period of the Muhammad Ali dynasty's reign, from the United Kingdom's recognition of Egyptian independence in 1922 until the abolition of the monarchy of Egypt and the Sudan in 1953 following the Egyptian Revolution of 1952. Until the Anglo-Egyptian treaty of 1936, the Kingdom was only nominally independent, as the United Kingdom retained control of foreign relations, communications, the military, and the territory of Anglo-Egyptian Sudan. Officially, Sudan was governed as a condominium of the two states; however, in reality, true power in Sudan lay with the United Kingdom. Between 1936 and 1953, the British continued to maintain their military presence in the Suez Canal, as well as influence over Egypt's political advisers, at a reduced level.

Hašemitsko kraljestvo Hedžas (arabsko: Al-Mamlakah al-Ḥijāziyyah Al-Hāshimiyyah) je bila država v pokrajini Hedžas v zahodni Aziji, ki je obsegala zahodni del Arabskega polotoka in ji je vladala hašemitska dinastija. Za kraljestvo se je razglasila junija 1916, med prvo svetovno vojno, da bi postala neodvisna od Osmanskega cesarstva, na podlagi zavezništva z Britanskim imperijem, s katerim naj bi med arabskim uporom pregnali osmansko vojsko z Arabskega polotoka.

source.title: Kingdom of Hejaz
paragraphs: The Hashemite Kingdom of Hejaz (Arabic: المملكة الحجازية الهاشمية, romanized: Al-Mamlakah al-Ḥijāziyyah Al-Hāshimiyyah) was a state in the Hejaz region of Western Asia that included the western portion of the Arabian Peninsula that was ruled by the Hashemite dynasty. It was self-proclaimed as a kingdom in June 1916 during the First World War, to be independent from the Ottoman Empire, on the basis of an alliance with the British Empire to drive the Ottoman Army from the Arabian Peninsula during the Arab Revolt.

Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd.headline: Kraljevina Hedžas in Nedžd
paragraphs: Tretja savdska država je sedanja savdska država in naslednica prvih dveh, ustanovil pa jo je Abdul Aziz bin Abdul Rahman (znan tudi kot Ibn Saud), ki je 13. januarja 1902 zavzel mesto Rijad. Dolga vrsta spopadov in osvajanj je nazadnje pripeljala do nastanka sodobne savdske države, Kraljevine Savdske Arabije.

Tretja savdska država se je na začetku imenovala »Emirat Rijad« (1902–1913) in »Emirat Nedžd in Hasa« (1913–1921). Ko je strmoglavila tekmeca, Emirat Hail, in tako dobila nadzor nad vso pokrajino Nedžd, se je preimenovala v Sultanat Nedžd. Abdul Aziz je leta 1925 osvojil Kraljevino Hedžas, leta 1927 pa je Nedžd povzdignil v kraljevino, njegova posest pa se je odtlej imenovala Kraljevina Hedžas in Nedžd s pridruženimi ozemlji. Oba dela dvojne kraljevine je upravljal ločeno, dokler ni priključil Južnega ozemlja in leta 1932 razglasil ustanovitve Kraljevine Savdske Arabije.

source.title: Third Saudi state
paragraphs: The third Saudi state is the current Saudi state and successor to the two earlier states: the first and the second, founded by Abdul Aziz bin Abdul Rahman (also known as "Ibn Saud"), who managed to capture the city of Riyadh on January 13, 1902. A long series of conflicts and conquests ultimately led to the establishment of the modern and contemporary Saudi state, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

The third Saudi state was known at the beginning of its reign as "the Emirate of Riyadh" (1902–1913) and "the Emirate of Nejd and Hasa" (1913–1921). After the overthrow of the rival Emirate of Ha'il, which gave the Emirate of Najd and Al-Ahsa control of the entire Nejd region, it became known as the Sultanate of Nejd. Abdul Aziz conquered the Kingdom of Hejaz in 1925. He raised Nejd to a kingdom in 1927, and his dominions became known as the Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd and its annexes. Abdul Aziz administered the two portions of his dual kingdom separately until the annexation of the Southern Territory and the announcement of the establishment of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932.

Hašemitska Kraljevina Irak je bila iraška država na Bližnjem vzhodu, ki je obstajala od leta 1932 do 1958. Kot Kraljevino Irak so jo ustanovili 23. avgusta 1921, po porazu Osmanskega cesarstva v mezopotamski kampanji prve svetovne vojne. Društvo narodov je mandat sicer leta 1920 podelilo Združenemu kraljestvu, a je zaradi iraškega upora istega leta prvotni načrt mandata propadel; nadomestila ga je formalno suverena iraška kraljevina, ki pa je bila dejansko pod britansko upravo. Načrt je formalno uveljavila angleško-iraška pogodba. Kraljevina je imela ob ustanovitvi leta 1928 2,8 milijona prebivalcev, ob koncu leta 1958 pa 6,5 milijona.

source.title: Kingdom of Iraq
paragraphs: The Hashemite Kingdom of Iraq was the Iraqi state located in the Middle East from 1932 to 1958. It was founded on 23 August 1921 as the Kingdom of Iraq, following the defeat of the Ottoman Empire in the Mesopotamian campaign of the World War I. Although a League of Nations mandate was awarded to the United Kingdom in 1920, the 1920 Iraqi revolt resulted in the scrapping of the original mandate plan in favour of a formally sovereign Iraqi kingdom, but one that was under effective British administration. The plan was formally established by the Anglo-Iraqi Treaty. The population of the Kingdom was 2.8 million at the founding in 1928, and by the end of the Kingdom in 1958 it was 6.5 million.

Kraljestvo Juda je bilo izraelsko kraljestvo na južnem Levantu v železni dobi. Središče je imelo v višavju zahodno od Mrtvega morja, prestolnica pa je bil Jeruzalem. Štiri stoletja mu je vladala Davidova rodbina. Judje so dobili ime po Judi in izhajajo predvsem od ljudi, ki so živeli na tem območju.

source.title: Kingdom of Judah
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Judah was an Israelite kingdom of the Southern Levant during the Iron Age. Centered in the highlands to the west of the Dead Sea, the kingdom's capital was Jerusalem. It was ruled by the House of David for four centuries. Jews are named after Judah, and primarily descend from people who lived in the region.

Kraljevina Portugalska je bila monarhija na zahodu Iberskega polotoka in predhodnica sodobne Portugalske republike. V različnem obsegu je obstajala od sredine 12. do začetka 20. stoletja, po letu 1471 pa so jo imenovali tudi Kraljevina Portugalska in Algarve. Bila je glavni del Združenega kraljestva Portugalske, Brazilije in Algarvov, ki je obstajalo med letoma 1815 in 1822. Obstajala je ob Portugalskem imperiju, čezmorskih kolonijah kraljestva.

Jedro portugalske države je bila Portugalska grofija, ki jo je v 9. stoletju v okviru rekonkviste ustanovil Vímara Peres, vazal asturijskega kralja. Grofija je leta 1097 postala del Kraljevine León, portugalski grofje pa so se v 12. stoletju, po bitki pri São Mamedeju, uveljavili kot vladarji neodvisnega kraljestva. Kraljestvu je vladala afonzinska dinastija do portugalskega medvladja v letih 1383–1385, nato pa je monarhija prešla na rodbino Aviz.

source.title: Kingdom of Portugal
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Portugal was a monarchy in the western Iberian Peninsula and the predecessor of the modern Portuguese Republic. Existing to various extents between the mid-12th century and the early 20th century, it was also known as the Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves after 1471, and was the main constituent of the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves, which existed between 1815 and 1822. It coexisted with the Portuguese Empire, the realm's overseas colonies.

The nucleus of the Portuguese state was the County of Portugal, established in the 9th century as part of the Reconquista by Vímara Peres, a vassal of the King of Asturias. The county became part of the Kingdom of León in 1097, and the Counts of Portugal established themselves as rulers of an independent kingdom in the 12th century, following the Battle of São Mamede. The kingdom was ruled by the Afonsine dynasty until the 1383–1385 Portuguese interregnum, after which the monarchy passed to the House of Aviz.

Laomedon of Mytilene.headline: Laomedont iz Mitilene
paragraphs: Laomedont (grško: Λαoμέδων ὁ Μυτιληναῖος; živel v 4. stoletju pr. n. št.) je bil grški vojskovodja iz Mitilene, Larihov sin. Bil je eden od generalov Aleksandra Velikega in je, kot kaže, užival njegovo zaupanje že pred smrtjo Filipa II., saj ga je ta vladar (skupaj z bratom Erigijem, Ptolemajem, Nearhom in drugimi) izgnal, ker je sodeloval v spletkah mladega princa.

Po Filipovi smrti leta 336 pr. n. št. je Aleksander Laomedonta, tako kot druge, ki so tedaj trpeli, kar najbolj častil: Laomedont ga je spremljal v Azijo, kjer so mu, ker je znal perzijsko, zaupali ujetnike. Čeprav ga v poznejših Aleksandrovih vojnah ne omenjajo več, njegov visoki ugled dovolj potrjuje to, da je po kraljevi smrti leta 323 pr. n. št. pri delitvi provinc dobil pomembno upravo Sirije.

source.title: Laomedon of Mytilene
paragraphs: Laomedon (Greek: Λαoμέδων ὁ Μυτιληναῖος; lived during the 4th century BC) was a Greek military commander, native of Mytilene and son of Larichus. He was one of Alexander the Great's generals, and appears to have enjoyed a high place in his confidence even before the death of Philip II, as he was one of those banished by that monarch (together with his brother Erigyius, Ptolemy, Nearchus, and others) for taking part in the intrigues of the young prince.

After the death of Philip in 336 BC, Laomedon, in common with the others who had suffered on this occasion, was held by Alexander in the highest honour: he accompanied him to Asia, where, on account of his acquaintance with the Persian language, he was appointed in charge of the captives. Though his name is not afterwards mentioned during the wars of Alexander, the high consideration he enjoyed is sufficiently attested by his obtaining in the division of the provinces, after the king's death in 323 BC, the important government of Syria.

Mahdids.headline: Mahdidi
paragraphs: Mahdidi (arabsko: Banī Mahdī) so bili dinastija v Jemnu, ki je bila za kratek čas na oblasti med letoma 1159 in 1174.

source.title: Mahdids
paragraphs: The Mahdids (Arabic: بني مهدي, romanized: Banī Mahdī) were a dynasty in Yemen who briefly held power in the period between 1159 and 1174.

Mandat za Sirijo in Libanon (francosko: Mandat pour la Syrie et le Liban; arabsko: al-intidāb al-faransī ʻalā sūriyā wa-lubnān), imenovan tudi levantske države (1923–1946), je bil mandat Društva narodov, ustanovljen po prvi svetovni vojni in razdelitvi Osmanskega cesarstva za ozemlji Sirije in Libanona. Mandatni sistem naj bi se razlikoval od kolonializma: upravljavska država naj bi delovala kot skrbnica, dokler prebivalci ne bi bili sposobni samouprave. Tedaj bi se mandat končal in rodila bi se suverena država.

source.title: Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon
paragraphs: The Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon (French: Mandat pour la Syrie et le Liban; Arabic: الانتداب الفرنسي على سوريا ولبنان, romanized: al-intidāb al-faransī ʻalā sūriyā wa-lubnān, also referred to as the Levant States; 1923−1946) was a League of Nations mandate founded in the aftermath of the First World War and the partitioning of the Ottoman Empire concerning the territories of Syria and Lebanon. The mandate system was supposed to differ from colonialism, with the governing country intended to act as a trustee until the inhabitants were considered eligible for self-government. At that point, the mandate would terminate, and a sovereign state would be born.

Median dynasty.headline: Medijska dinastija
paragraphs: Medija (staroperzijsko: Māda; grško: Μηδία; akadsko: Mādāya) je bila politična tvorba s središčem v Ekbatani, ki je obstajala od 7. stoletja do sredine 6. stoletja pr. n. št. in je domnevno obvladovala velik del Iranske planote, pred mogočnim Ahemenidskim imperijem. Pogosto vmešavanje Asircev v pokrajino Zagros je spodbudilo združevanje medijskih plemen. Do leta 612 pr. n. št. so se Medijci dovolj okrepili, da so v zavezništvu z Babilonci strmoglavili propadajoče Asirsko cesarstvo. Sodobni raziskovalci pa dvomijo, da je enotno medijsko kraljestvo ali država obstajala vsaj večji del 7. stoletja pr. n. št.

Po starogrškem zgodovinarju Herodotu so medijsko dinastijo sestavljali štirje kralji, ki so medijskemu imperiju vladali 150 let. Če je Herodotova pripoved točna, je Medijce združil mož po imenu Dejok, prvi od štirih kraljev medijskega imperija, mogočne države, ki je obsegala velike dele Irana in vzhodne Anatolije.

source.title: Median dynasty
paragraphs: Media (Old Persian: 𐎶𐎠𐎭 Māda; Greek: Μηδία Mēdía; Akkadian: Mādāya) was a political entity centered in Ecbatana that existed from the 7th century BC until the mid-6th century BC and is believed to have dominated a significant portion of the Iranian plateau, preceding the powerful Achaemenid Empire. The frequent interference of the Assyrians in the Zagros region led to the process of unifying the Median tribes. By 612 BC, the Medes became strong enough to overthrow the declining Assyrian empire in alliance with the Babylonians. However, contemporary scholarship tends to be skeptical about the existence of a united Median kingdom or state, at least for most of the 7th century BCE.

The Median dynasty was, according to the ancient Greek historian Herodotus, a dynasty composed of four kings who ruled for 150 years under the Median Empire. If Herodotus' story is accurate, the Medes were unified by a man named Deioces, the first of the four kings who would rule the Median Empire; a mighty empire that included large parts of Iran and eastern Anatolia.

Minaeans.headline: Minejci
paragraphs: Main (minejsko: 𐩣𐩲𐩬; arabsko: Maʿīn) je bilo starodavno južnoarabsko kraljestvo v današnjem Jemnu. Ležalo je ob puščavskem pasu, ki so ga srednjeveški arabski geografi imenovali Sajhad, danes pa je znan kot Ramlat as Sabatajn. Narodni bog Maina je bil Vad, govorili pa so minejščino. Kraljestvo se v zgodovinskih virih pojavi v 8. stoletju pr. n. št., iz mestne države pa se je v kraljestvo preoblikovalo v zadnji četrtini 7. stoletja pr. n. št. O datumu konca Maina se raziskovalci močno prerekajo, po najbolj razširjeni domnevi pa je propadel v 1. stoletju n. št.

Minejci so bili ena od štirih starodavnih jemenskih skupin, ki jih omenja Eratosten; druge so bile Sabejci, Hadramavtci in Katabanci. Vsaka je imela v starodavnem Jemnu svoje regionalno kraljestvo: Minejci na severozahodu (v vadiju Al Džauf), Sabejci jugovzhodno od njih, Katabanci jugovzhodno od Sabejcev in Hadramavtci še vzhodneje.

source.title: Ma'in
paragraphs: Ma'in (Minaean: 𐩣𐩲𐩬; Arabic: معين, romanized: Maʿīn) was an ancient South Arabian kingdom in modern-day Yemen. It was located along the strip of desert called Ṣayhad by medieval Arab geographers, which is now known as Ramlat al-Sab'atayn. Wadd was the national god of Ma'in. The spoken language was Minaic. The kingdom appears in the historical record in the 8th century BCE, and transition from a city-state to kingdom in the last quarter of the 7th century BCE. The date of the end of Ma'in is heavily disputed, but the most popular hypothesis places its demise in the 1st century CE.

The Minaean people were one of four ancient Yemeni groups mentioned by Eratosthenes. The others were the Sabaeans, Ḥaḍramites and Qatabānians. Each of these had regional kingdoms in ancient Yemen, with the Minaeans in the north-west (in Wādī al-Jawf), the Sabaeans to the south-east of them, the Qatabānians to the south-east of the Sabaeans, and the Ḥaḑramites further east still.

Muškat in Oman (arabsko: مسقط و عُمان), uradno Sultanat Muškat in Oman (Salṭanat Masqaṭ wa-‘Umān), med vladavino Tajmurja bin Fejsala za kratek čas tudi Država Muškat in Oman, je bila država pod dejansko britansko zaščito, ki je obstajala v drugi polovici 19. stoletja in v 20. stoletju.
